title: spec, docs: the permission-set name describe and the permission-sets page say one name per namespace
body:
epic:#31527#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgXQnNkXTT1Wu7i7Y3i

Skills-docs follow-up of #31698 PR 2 (PR #32742, `Metadata-protocol: added`). With that PR a permission-set name is held once per namespace, so two published texts become false:

- `packages/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts:1207-1208` — the `name` describe still reads "unique within the security catalog the environment serves".
- `content/docs/permissions/permission-sets.mdx:430` — "permission sets, positions and capabilities hold one name per deployment".

TO: both say a permission set is identified by (package, name), one holder per namespace; positions and capabilities keep one name per deployment; co-owners of one namespace, a package with no namespace, the platform namespaces and `guest_portal` keep one holder. `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` already teaches the (package, name) identity (checked by the PR's dev).

Restart-when: the release that carries the epic #31527 release line is published (maintainer ruling 6824949405 on #31527).
